request.specialRequirements: One of us uses a wheelchair. We need step-free access at sights and an accessible hotel room.

itinerary.title: 4-day Accessible Cultural Trip: Mumbai → Delhi (Nov 28–Dec 1, 2026)
itinerary.summary: Compact, accessible cultural itinerary for 2 adults (no children). Mid‑range, step‑free hotel; flights estimated; all meals at vegetarian or pure‑veg restaurants. 3 cultural activities per day (museums, monuments, heritage walks). Budget kept well under the INR 40,000 group limit with ~8% contingency.

outbound.description: Mumbai (BOM) → Delhi (DEL). Economy round-trip fare estimate; request wheelchair assistance at booking and at check‑in.
outbound.departure: Morning (suggest 07:00–10:00) - book an early flight so you have time for afternoon sightseeing

return.description: Delhi (DEL) → Mumbai (BOM). Return flight; request wheelchair assistance for boarding and arrival.
return.departure: Afternoon (allow 2–3 hours from hotel to airport for accessible transfer & check‑in)

transport.local: Use pre-booked accessible taxis (app or hotel car) for airport transfers and longer hops; use accessible/flat-route metro where possible (ask station staff for step-free access). For short intra‑city trips prefer accessible taxis rather than crowded buses/old markets.

accommodation.name: Ibis Hotel (central New Delhi) — request accessible room on booking
accommodation.area: Central New Delhi / near Connaught Place
accommodation.why: Mid‑range, central location for shorter transfers between heritage and museum areas; hotels in this category commonly offer accessible rooms on request — confirm step-free access & roll‑in shower when booking.

days.theme: Arrival + modern art & city walk (flexible for light rain)
days.weather: Typically: mostly dry, light rain possible (tMax 23.8°C / tMin 13.2°C)

activities.name: Hotel check-in & short rest
activities.description: Arrive, complete accessible check‑in, leave luggage in room. Confirm accessible room features with front desk.

activities.name: Kiran Nadar Museum of Art
activities.description: Contemporary art museum with accessible entrances and lifts (confirm on arrival). Good introduction to modern Indian art.

activities.name: Lodhi Art District (outdoor walk)
activities.description: Short, level outdoor walk among accessible streets to see public murals and sculptures. Do only if weather is dry; otherwise relax at the hotel or enjoy a longer museum visit.

meals.place: Adyar Ananda Bhavan (A2B) or similar pure‑veg South Indian restaurant
Bikanervala (pure veg sweets & north Indian dishes)

days.notes: Ask the museum and hotel ahead to confirm step‑free access and lifts. Short public walks can be skipped if it starts raining; use the time for an extra museum or rest.

days.theme: Delhi’s older monuments and Lutyens-era museums (clear day)

activities.name: Jamali Kamali Tomb (Mehrauli) & nearby Iron Pillar (Qutub area)
activities.description: Visit the Jamali‑Kamali tomb (historic monument) and the nearby Iron Pillar in the Qutub area. Paths in the Qutub area are partly paved — check for step-free access; the Iron Pillar itself is in a mostly level open area.

activities.name: Lunch at Veg Gulati or similar pure‑veg restaurant
activities.description: Well known vegetarian restaurant for classic North Indian dishes.

activities.name: Teen Murti Bhavan (museum)
activities.description: Museum and memorial in Lutyens' Delhi; largely step‑free interiors and accessible pathways (confirm access at entrance).

meals.place: Bikanervala (or another pure‑veg sweet & casual dining)

days.notes: Qutub/Jamali area has some uneven surfaces; bring a companion to assist on short rough patches. Teen Murti is in central Delhi making transfers short.

days.theme: Museums & memorials — indoor day (light rain possible)
days.weather: Typically: mostly dry, light rain possible (tMax 23.2°C / tMin 12.6°C)

activities.name: Partition Museum (New Delhi location)
activities.description: Museum focused on the Partition story — indoor exhibits and galleries; request step‑free routing at the entry.

activities.name: Madame Tussaud’s Museum
activities.description: Wax museum with accessible areas and lifts; good indoor activity for a light‑rain day.

activities.name: Diwan‑e‑Aam (Red Fort area, external visit)
activities.description: View the Hall of Public Audience and adjacent areas (some parts level and accessible; confirm step‑free routes at the entry gate).

meals.place: Bikanervala or local pure‑veg restaurant near hotel

days.notes: Indoor museums are prioritized today in case of light rain. For the Red Fort external visit, confirm accessible entrance points in advance.

days.weather: Typically: mostly dry, light rain possible (tMax 24.4°C / tMin 12.7°C)

activities.name: National Zoological Park (short accessible walk / viewing)
activities.description: Paved routes in many parts of the zoo; plan a short 1.5–2 hour visit focused on accessible enclosures and viewpoints.

activities.name: Return to hotel, check‑out
activities.description: Pack, settle bills, and prepare for accessible transfer to airport. Allow buffer time for traffic and accessible transfer.

activities.name: Transfer to airport & depart
activities.description: Accessible taxi to Delhi airport for return flight home.

meals.place: Airport restaurant with vegetarian menu (e.g., Adyar Ananda Bhavan outlet or similar)

days.notes: Allow ample time for accessible transfer and airport formalities. Confirm wheelchair assistance when booking flights and reconfirm 24–48 hours before travel.

packingTips: Bring a small umbrella or light rain jacket (light rain possible on 28th & 30th).
Portable seat cushion and a small bag for museum brochures; some older monuments have uneven surfaces so a companion may be needed for short transfers.
Copies of medical ID and any mobility aid details; request airline and hotel wheelchair assistance in writing/email and save confirmations.
Comfortable shoes for the companion (some outdoor sites have short uneven patches).
tips: When booking the hotel and flights, explicitly request an accessible room and wheelchair assistance for both departure and arrival. Ask the hotel to confirm a roll‑in shower or grab bars if needed.
Carry physical copies of reservation confirmations and a local contact number in case drivers need directions to accessible entrances.
Prefer pre‑booked accessible taxis for airport transfers rather than relying on finding a vehicle on the street; apps usually allow adding 'assistance required' notes.
Most listed restaurants (Bikanervala, Veg Gulati, Adyar Ananda Bhavan) are vegetarian or have extensive veg menus; still reconfirm no egg/meat is served if you want pure‑veg kitchen assurance.
